note: ⚠️ SNG-311/316. The vocabulary a charge tracker evaluates. `upkeep.prepCondition` and `upkeep.rateBySource` on 17 crafts name conditions in words; this says what SATISFIES each one, so the tick can decide how much a pass banks without a human reading prose.

accrualKinds.rate: every pass banks something; the source sets the multiplier. There is no zero pass unless the source itself is zero.
accrualKinds.gate: a pass banks its full hours or nothing. Half-satisfying a gate banks nothing.

clear noon.evaluate: light level at the vessel's location
clear noon.note: ⚠️ NOT a gate. Erik's correction: the Well runs whenever there is light of any kind and is merely fastest at noon.

inputs: whether an ally spent an action feeding it

uninterrupted sleep.evaluate: the pass contained a full rest that was not broken
uninterrupted sleep.satisfiedBy: a rest of 8+ hours with no encounter resolved during it

same camp.evaluate: the bearer ended the pass at the same location as the previous pass
same camp.note: ⚠️ THE ONLY CONDITION WHOSE FAILURE RESETS THE COUNT TO ZERO rather than pausing it — a named place is made by continuity, so a broken run is not a shorter run, it is a different run.

daily training.evaluate: how much of the pass went to deliberate practice
inputs: how the character spent their beats
daily training.note: a rate on Erik's principle generalised: partial training is not nothing

community consent.satisfiedBy: standing at or above `accepted` in the community holding the ward
community consent.note: ⚠️ THE ONLY CONDITION SOMEONE ELSE CAN REVOKE. A prism ward is not yours; it is theirs and you maintain it.

impersonation held.evaluate: the assumed identity is unbroken and the records still stand
impersonation held.satisfiedBy: no record of the original restored, and the impersonation not publicly exposed
impersonation held.note: ⚠️ THE ONLY CONDITION AN OPPONENT CAN END DELIBERATELY, and it ends the whole working rather than pausing it — which is the counterplay to a 90-day erasure.

display.rule: ⚠️ COUNT THE CONDITION, NOT THE HOURS. 'Light Well — 5 of 7 clear noons banked' beats '71%', and when the source is weather-gated the remaining hours are not knowable anyway. Show hours only where the condition is plain elapsed time.
display.advanced: one line when a pass banks, naming the source: 'A clear noon. The vessels take it.'
display.blocked: ⚠️ REQUIRED — one line when a pass banks little or nothing: 'Overcast. The Well took almost nothing today.' A stalled counter that is silent reads as a bug.
display.nearCapacity: ⚠️ REQUIRED at 90%+: the vessel's authored warning line, so the player can choose to vent before it bursts.

forCCode: all inputs above already exist on the world clock, location records, rest log and standing tables. The tracker needs `character.charges[]` advanced in the assignments tick pass; nothing new is recorded. Rates multiply the pass's hours; gates bank all or nothing.
